jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Collect, process, and analyze data to provide actionable insights that support business decisions.

Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools to track key performance indicators (KPIs).

Work closely with cross-functional teams to identify data trends, patterns, and opportunities for process improvement.

Clean, validate, and interpret large datasets from multiple sources to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

Assist in developing predictive models and automation tools to enhance data-driven decision-making.

Present findings and recommendations to management and stakeholders in a clear, concise manner.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field.

Proven experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or similar analytical roles.

Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

Knowledge of Python or R for data processing and statistical analysis is an advantage.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Ability to work independently and handle multiple projects simultaneously.

Benefits:

Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses.

Opportunities for professional growth and advanced data training.

Collaborative and innovative work culture.

Flexible or hybrid working arrangements.

Data Entry - Data Analyst Full Time (100% Remote)

Role Overview

We are hiring a Data Entry and Reporting Analyst to support our business intelligence and operations team from home. This fully remote role is open to candidates within the United States and involves collecting, organizing, entering, and analyzing data across internal systems and generating reports for management review. Due to access to sensitive business and client data, a background check and credit screening are required for all analyst positions.

This is an entry-level, United States-based remote role. Work is assigned through digital tools and reviewed using established procedures. Candidates should be comfortable asking questions when instructions or source records are incomplete.

Key Responsibilities

Collect, clean, and accurately enter data from multiple internal and external sources into company databases and spreadsheets.
Generate daily, weekly, and monthly summary reports using Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or internal reporting tools.
Identify data inconsistencies, gaps, or anomalies and flag them for supervisor review with clear documentation.
Maintain organized and up-to-date digital records across multiple databases and file systems.
Collaborate with team leads to define key metrics, build tracking templates, and streamline reporting workflows.
Support management with data-driven summaries and insights to assist in operational decision-making.
Assist with audits, reconciliations, and data quality checks on a scheduled basis.
Meet daily data entry accuracy and productivity targets as set by the team.

Entry-Level Qualifications

High school diploma required; associate or bachelor degree in a related field preferred.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets with a strong understanding of data organization.
Strong analytical thinking with excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
Comfortable working with large data sets and maintaining consistency across multiple files.
Reliable internet connection and a quiet, distraction-free home workspace.
Must pass a pre-employment background check and credit screening.
No prior analyst experience required — comprehensive paid training is provided.
Must be authorized to work in the United States.

Working Arrangement

Location:
United States. Workplace:
Remote. Employment:
Full-time. Experience level:
Entry level.

How Work Is Evaluated

Successful work is accurate, timely, clearly documented, and completed with respect for confidential information. New team members are expected to follow established workflows, communicate blockers early, and seek feedback when learning unfamiliar tasks.

Compensation

Salary range: $40,000 - $55,000 per year

jobs.description:
Posting location:
Ohio. Workplace type:
Remote. Remote work within the United States.

Data Analyst (Remote)

Work arrangement:
Remote within the United States. Employment type:
Full-time.

Position overview

The Data Analyst position focuses on turning organized datasets into dependable reports, visual summaries and useful observations. The position calls for thoughtful handling of routine tasks, reliable documentation and a consistent approach to changing priorities.

How the work is approached

The role moves from raw information to a clearer picture of what the numbers indicate. That progression involves cleaning source material, checking unusual results, building repeatable reports and explaining patterns in language others can understand. An interesting result is only useful when its source and limitations are clear, so documenting assumptions is as important as producing a neat table or chart.

Core responsibilities

Clean and organize data from approved sources.
Build recurring reports and simple dashboards.
Verify data quality and investigate unusual results.
Summarize patterns and actionable findings.

Contribution and outcomes

Careful analysis helps teams discuss patterns using consistent information rather than isolated impressions. By checking accuracy and making results understandable, the analyst contributes to more informed follow-up questions and clearer routine reporting.

Remote collaboration

A well-organized remote routine leaves a clear trail of decisions, document changes and unresolved questions. Timely communication is especially useful when work passes between people who do not share the same office or working schedule.

Quality and consistency

Consistent results come from a repeatable process: check the request, organize the relevant details, complete the authorized action and review the outcome. If the available information does not support a conclusion, the record should make that limitation visible.

Relevant capabilities

Excel and spreadsheet analysis.
Basic SQL or reporting tools helpful.
Clear documentation and attention to detail.

What dependable performance looks like

Success in the role is reflected in clear records, appropriate handling of exceptions and dependable completion of agreed tasks. Each careful update makes the next step easier for the people who rely on the information. The role particularly values structured analysis, precise documentation and curious investigation.

jobs.title: Professional Civil Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description

Wonderful Pistachios & Almonds is the largest vertically integrated pistachio and almond processor in the world. Located in California's Central Valley, our nuts are Non-GMO Project Verified and sustainably harvested, providing a smart, healthy choice for consumers around the world. Our facilities are equipped with the most advanced processing technology available, allowing us to efficiently sort, grade, process, roast, flavor, and package billions of nuts each year. We are committed to providing the highest-quality nuts to our customers and consumers worldwide.

Job Description

SUMMARY OF POSITION

The Professional Civil Engineer is responsible for planning, designing, managing, and overseeing civil engineering projects that support plant operations, infrastructure improvements, and facility expansion. This position ensures projects comply with California engineering regulations, applicable building codes, safety standards, budgets, and timelines. The Civil Engineer collaborates with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and external contractors to develop cost-effective solutions, improve infrastructure reliability, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Plan, design, and oversee civil engineering projects, including site development, grading, drainage, foundations, utilities, roadways, and facility infrastructure improvements.
Prepare, review, and approve engineering drawings, technical specifications, calculations, and construction documents in accordance with applicable California regulations and engineering standards, including review of vendor and contractor structural submittals and equipment anchorage designs.
Design, review, sign, and seal civil and structural engineering drawings and calculations within the scope of professional licensure, competency, and responsible charge including structural steel equipment platforms, mezzanines, catwalks, stairs, ladders, pipe and conveyors supports, and equipment anchorage subject to vibrating and dynamic equipment loads.
Evaluate the structural integrity of foundations, equipment support, buildings, and existing plant structures, including their capacity for added equipment loads, and provide engineering recommendations.
Manage engineering projects from initial planning through completion, ensuring compliance with established budgets, timelines, quality standards, and safety requirements.
Conduct site inspections and engineering assessments to evaluate existing infrastructure, identify deficiencies, and recommend corrective actions or improvements.
Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, contractors, consultants, and regulatory agencies to ensure successful project execution.
Ensure compliance with applicable California Building Standards Code requirements, environmental regulations, permitting requirements, and company safety policies.
Develop project budgets, cost estimates, feasibility studies, and recommendations for infrastructure improvements, equipment installations, and capital investments.
Oversee contractors and construction activities to verify work meets approved engineering plans, specifications, and project requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve facility infrastructure, operational efficiency, reliability, and long-term maintenance through engineering solutions.
Lead problem-solving and continuous improvement initiatives using PDCA methodologies to address recurring infrastructure and operational challenges.
Provide technical guidance and engineering recommendations to management, project teams, and cross-functional departments.
Maintain accurate engineering documentation, project records, permits, inspection reports, and regulatory compliance records.
Develop, monitor, maintain, and analyze departmental Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), communicate performance results during Floor Management Development System (FMDS) meetings, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Support long-term facility planning, including infrastructure upgrades, expansion projects, and capital improvement initiatives.
Deliver exceptional customer service by responding to internal and external customer needs, building positive relationships, and ensuring timely and effective resolution of concerns.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree in civil or Structural Engineering from an ABET-accredited program; MS in structural engineering preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of civil engineering experience, including at least 3 years designing industrial steel and concrete structures with a record of sealed structural drawings and calculations, preferably involving industrial facilities, manufacturing operations, infrastructure, or construction project management.
Experience managing capital projects, contractors, engineering consultants, and construction activities.
Working knowledge of California Building Code (including its structural and seismic provisions), ASCE 7 (including nonbuilding structures and equipment anchorage), AISC steel design standards, ACI 318 concrete design and anchoring, Cal/OSHA and federal OSHA requirements for platforms, guardrails, stairs, and ladders, permitting processes, and applicable environmental regulations.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and in structural analysis and design software such as RISA, STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, or Enercalc.
Experience preparing engineering calculations, construction drawings, technical specifications, and cost estimates.
Strong understanding of project management, budgeting, and continuous improvement methodologies.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Active California Professional Engineer (P.E.) license in Civil Engineering required; California Structural Engineer (S.E) license preferred.

Pay range: $110,000 - $150,000/yr

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

EEO is the law - click here for more information
